## History

Before relocating, James A lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott three years prior due to her independent wealth and homemaking abilities. Having previously visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy and taken a liking to it, he eventually moved there.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_
